# ShapeHaven Innovations

> Boutique software consultancy specializing in iOS app development, custom software, web applications, backend systems, code refactoring, automation/DevOps, and technical consulting. Also builds and operates production SaaS products: ReturnIQ, CondoGuard, and KavaCrawl.

ShapeHaven Innovations LLC is a small, independent software studio. Work is open-source where possible; clients own their code, data, and infrastructure (no vendor lock-in).

## Services

- iOS Apps & Architecture - native iOS development with clean architecture and performance optimization.
- Websites & Web Apps - responsive, fast, accessible sites and web applications.
- Code Refactoring - modernizing legacy codebases, reducing technical debt.
- Backend & Integrations - API design, backend services, third-party integrations.
- Automation & DevOps - CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation.
- Technical Consulting - architecture, technology selection, performance, debugging.

## Products

- [ReturnIQ](https://returniq.shapehaveninnovations.com/) - Shopify app for AI-powered returns management and analytics, helping merchants cut loss and streamline logistics.
- [CondoGuard](https://condoguard.app/) - property and condo management app for boards, owners, and residents.
- [KavaCrawl](https://kavacrawl.shapehaveninnovations.com/) - web crawling and data collection platform built for reliability at scale.
